reason: An observability plugin for DeepSeek Harness that converts agent, LLM, and tool lifecycle events into OpenTelemetry traces and metrics for export to compatible monitoring backends; content capture is optional and disabled by default.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 采集智能体、LLM 与工具生命周期数据，并通过 OTLP 导出 OpenTelemetry 链路和指标到兼容的观测后端。
summaries.en: Collects DeepSeek Harness agent, LLM, and tool lifecycle data and exports OpenTelemetry traces and metrics over OTLP to compatible observability backends.

capabilities: Observes DeepSeek Harness session, agent, LLM stream, and tool lifecycles
Exports OpenTelemetry traces and metrics over OTLP/HTTP to a configured backend
Can optionally capture and transmit prompts, responses, tool definitions, arguments, and results
Supports configurable endpoints, headers, service names, resource attributes, and export settings
